costs.note: gas_burnt and tokens_burnt of the whole transaction (all receipts), epoch 2, 210 edges, 15 members, fees 10 and 5 bps; testnet gas price 1e9 yoctoNEAR per gas at the time
costs.minimum_balance_to_send: a transaction reserves its prepaid gas times the gas price (1 Tgas = 0.001 NEAR on testnet) and refunds what is not burnt: prepaid 250 Tgas needs 0.25 NEAR, 60 Tgas for submit_clearing (28 used) needs 0.06 NEAR, 150 Tgas for commit_epoch (69 used) needs 0.15 NEAR

result.run1: run 1 registered 210 edges of epoch 1 and closed it, then stopped at submit_clearing: the solver account m00 had 0.24 NEAR and the transaction reserved 0.25 NEAR for 250 Tgas of prepaid gas (NotEnoughBalanceError); the proposal window of epoch 1 passed, epoch 1 stays in clearing without a proposal. Run 2 used epoch 2 with the circle account as solver.
